description: Create the ai-summary plugin with AWS Bedrock integration. This plugin adds an API endpoint to generate AI summaries for documents using Amazon Bedrock (Claude Sonnet model). It includes: plugin registration, environment configuration for Bedrock credentials, a background task to call the Bedrock API, an API endpoint to trigger summary generation, and the summary is stored in the existing Document.summary field.
steps: Step 1: Create plugins/ai-summary/plugin.json following the pattern of plugins/slack/plugin.json. Set id to 'ai-summary', name to 'AI Summary', and add a description.

Step 2: Create plugins/ai-summary/server/env.ts following plugins/slack/server/env.ts pattern. Define environment variables: AI_SUMMARY_BEDROCK_REGION (AWS region, default us-east-1), AI_SUMMARY_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID (model ID, default us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-20250514), AI_SUMMARY_BEDROCK_ACCESS_KEY_ID (optional, falls back to AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID), AI_SUMMARY_BEDROCK_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (optional, falls back to AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY). Use class-validator decorators.
Step 3: Install @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime package using yarn add @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime

Step 4: Create plugins/ai-summary/server/tasks/AISummaryTask.ts extending BaseTask. The task should: receive documentId and userId as props, load the document, convert to plain text using DocumentHelper.toPlainText(), call Bedrock InvokeModel API with Claude Sonnet to generate a summary (prompt: summarize the document in 2-3 sentences), save the summary to document.summary field, and fire an event.

Step 5: Create plugins/ai-summary/server/api/aiSummary.ts with a koa-router. Add POST endpoint 'aiSummary.generate' that: requires authentication, validates request (documentId required via zod schema), loads the document, checks user has read permission via authorize(), schedules the AISummaryTask, and returns success response with the document data.
Step 6: Create plugins/ai-summary/server/api/schema.ts with zod validation schema for the API endpoint (AISummaryGenerateSchema with body containing documentId as uuid).

Step 7: Create plugins/ai-summary/server/index.ts following plugins/slack/server/index.ts pattern. Register the plugin with PluginManager using Hook.API for the router and Hook.Task for AISummaryTask. Enable only when AI_SUMMARY_BEDROCK_REGION and credentials are configured.

Step 8: Create a test file plugins/ai-summary/server/tasks/AISummaryTask.test.ts that tests the task perform method with a mocked Bedrock client. Verify the document summary field is updated after the task runs.
acceptance_criteria: Plugin directory plugins/ai-summary/ exists with proper structure (plugin.json, server/index.ts, server/env.ts, server/api/, server/tasks/)
AISummaryTask correctly calls Bedrock API and updates document.summary
API endpoint aiSummary.generate is registered and accessible when plugin is enabled
Environment variables are properly validated with class-validator
Running yarn test plugins/ai-summary passes all tests
